What comes next, and where LODE 2 is used
Future development
Modules for RDF(S) vocabularies and SKOS taxonomies, then SHACL
Combined documentation of OWL ontologies and SHACL shapes
An optional OWL reasoner alongside the documentation-oriented inference
Already in use
All SPAR Ontologies are published with LODE 2
Automatic updates of the documentation when an ontology changes, via GitHub workflows
INFINITY project reuses LODE (OPINO ontology)
Planned usage
LUMIS: LODE becomes the documentation component of the LUMEN infrastructure for semantics
SKG-O: new documentation for the SKG-IF Ontology
